maria_cs: Quick flag 12pm PT 11/121 1 0241 1: Cedarbridge renewal due EOW. They approved 12-month commercial term but procurement will only issue a 9-month PO under a different billing entity. Legal + finance need to sync before invoicing. Who can triage? :eyes:
sam_ae: tagging Olivia and Jason. can procurement keep price parity if PO is 9mo?
bryan_cedarbridge: procurement constraint 1: we can only issue a 9mo PO this quarter. customer still wants the 12mo contract term. theyre asking for an invoice schedule that lines up to their PO.
jason_finance: operationally we can accept the 9mo PO if there's an addendum that ties it to a 12mo term and the invoicing schedule is explicit. need vendor code + legal entity + payment method. CC would speed things but they prefer PO.
maria_cs: suggested fallback: accept CC to avoid blocking onboarding, then attach PO when available. does that work for finance/legal?
olivia_legal: i'd prefer an addendum that explicitly references the PO and sets the invoice schedule. i'll draft language. question: will the list price be pro-rated because invoice timing shifts? need clarity before sign-off.
sam_ae: sales will hold price unchanged if customer signs the addendum + SOW. we can offer a one-time onboarding credit instead of changing ARR. less friction for procurement.
maria_cs: plan: Olivia drafts addendum; Jason confirms vendor code & invoice path; Sam confirms the onboarding credit and finalizes sales note; Bryan to secure PO scan and entity mapping. we should e-sign to speed this.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: Addendum (Cedarbridge) + Renewal SOW. Envelope ID: env-0a1b2c3d. Recipients: bryan_cedarbridge (signer), sam_ae (cc), olivia_legal (cc). Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-0a1b2c3d
bryan_cedarbridge: PO will arrive today. can you attach PO to the envelope or do we need a new envelope if PO is added?
maria_cs: you can upload the PO as an envelope attachment. Olivia, is that sufficient for legal records?
olivia_legal: attaching PO to the envelope is preferred. maria, when you have the scan upload it and i'll review.
jason_finance: vendor code: CB-USA-001. Billing entity: Cedarbridge Holdings, Inc. AP email: ap@cedarbridge.com. i'll need to be cc'd on the final envelope to trigger AR flow.
sam_ae: onboarding credit confirmed: $5,000 one-time applied on invoice 1; no ARR change. maria please include exact clause: 'one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 applied at invoice 1; no change to contract ARR or term.'
maria_cs: added credit clause to addendum draft and DocuSign fields. paused billable services until billing is active to avoid revenue leakage.
bryan_cedarbridge: PO# 984320 uploaded to envelope comments and procurement system. signing now. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
docusign-bot: Envelope env-0a1b2c3d completed by bryan_cedarbridge at 2024-11-12T15:23:10Z. Documents attached: Addendum.pdf, Renewal_SOW.pdf, PO_984320.pdf
maria_cs: Olivia, did the addendum language clear legal? can we proceed to invoice?
olivia_legal: reviewed and approved. made a minor signature-block tweak, resent. no further legal holds.
jason_finance: we'll issue Invoice 1 per the agreed schedule including -$5,000 onboarding credit, subsequent invoices per ARR installments. i'll mark account billable in AR tomorrow.
sam_ae: updating opportunity stage to 'Renewed'. note credit and addendum reference. good work team.
maria_cs: closing loop: onboarding paused until billing active; customer owner to re-schedule kickoff once invoice paid. thanks all. :heart:
